items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: So Chuck Max and his wife and my wife and I we rented a car and went to Niagara Falls.

ctx.x: ’42. People were making 20 dollars a week, 30 dollars. So I went on the road, and I took my wife with me. She quit her job, she came on the road with me, and the rest is history. Six months later we were in Niagara Falls, well Buffalo, we were playing a theater there. And we played a split week which means when you play the theater date you played seven days. When you did a split week you did three days in one and three days in another and you had one day off because Sunday was like Blue Law days you know. So we…
